paragraphs: Chapter 411
Episode 120. Why Target Hyeran? (5)
The masked man remained silent. It was impossible to guess what his expression might be like behind the mask.
"…I thought you'd finally made a proper decision to attack Dante Hyeran, but instead, you're complicating things, Jin Runecandle."
A proper decision—the masked man meant that it was advantageous for Runecandle that Dante was kidnapped.
It was because it benefited Runecandle.
Hyeran is the second-ranked sword after Runecandle and the core force of Bement, one of the four major powers.
Thus, the collapse of Hyeran would be equivalent to Bement suffering a severe blow.
Among the four major powers, Runecandle and Jiple are in clear opposition.
Bement and Kinzel's enmity was not yet clear.
However, Bement had many exchanges with Jiple since ancient times, and if they had to choose between Runecandle and Jiple to ally with, they were more likely to choose Jiple.
"You're the one complicating things. I was about to make Hyeran my ally, but now you're messing it all up?"
Swish! The black blade struck at the masked man's face. The masked man blocked it with his sword, but did not engage in a power struggle as if resisting the oppressive force.
'From what he's saying, it's certain. He's the Black Knight.'
He decided to be sure.

Whether he was the Black Knight or another warrior was not the crucial issue. The masked man was acting for the benefit of Runecandle, and it was obvious that he possessed the skills of a Black Knight.
"Get lost, you little dog of Joshua."
Whenever Bradamante was swung, the spirit and blue aura intertwined, leaving a sharp trajectory.
The masked man didn't directly block Jin's sword as he did in the first exchange, but instead easily dodged it.
There weren't many warriors in the world who could avoid Jin's determined attacks so cleanly.
However, only a handful could continue to dodge so 'effortlessly.'
At a glance, the masked man appeared to be at ease, but he was not. As Jin's attacks continued, the masked man's evasive range was narrowing.
'I see.'
Jin smiled inwardly as he observed the masked man's sword.

An ordinary steel sword—that was the reason why the masked man was avoiding crossing swords. It was not because he could effortlessly dodge Jin's attacks, and was waiting for the right moment to overpower him in a single strike.
'If he had brought his usual sword or a famous sword, it would have been incriminating evidence that he couldn't conceal.'
Of course, by Jin's standards, it might be considered ordinary, but it was a sword that any blacksmith would deem excellent.
However, that ordinary steel sword was facing Bradamante.
One of the greatest masterpieces completed by the legendary blacksmith Picon Minche, who became a god.
Some people believe that for the enlightened warriors, in other words, for those who are so powerful that the quality of their weapons is not important, the concept of a famous sword is meaningless.
But that's just the vain imagination of those who have never held a real sword.
When two warriors with equal strength fight, the winner is naturally the one with the better weapon.
That's why Siron used the unparalleled sword Barisada, Ron used Rashid, and Talris used Manbing. It was the same for all the other warriors.
Even a well-forged steel sword could not withstand the transcendent power of its user and could break.
'Already, my sword has been worn down from clashing with Dante and fighting against the knights of Highran, the durability of the steel sword is hitting rock bottom.'

If the weapon breaks in such a situation, even the Black Knight could not fight against Jin with his bare hands. Unfortunately for Dante, but fortunately for Jin, the Emperor's Sword of Light had filled the battlefield and destroyed all the swords of the fallen.
If the sword were to break right now, the villain would have no other weapon to acquire.
Jin smiled slyly.
"How are you going to handle it if you're so openly worried about your weapon, Black Knight?"
He increased his speed.
He unfolded the curtain of aura again and tirelessly shot sword energy between it. The heavy energy weighed down on the villain.
The villain could no longer dodge and began to deflect some of the sword energy.
Unable to properly utilize his own strength while desperately defending, he was at a disadvantage. In contrast, Jin calmly unleashed his sword energy.
'The only weapon he can acquire is Dante's sword.'
He positioned himself with the fallen Dante in mind. If the Black Knight were to obtain Dante's sword, the situation would naturally reverse.
"Shouldn't you have brought a spare weapon?"
With a loud metallic sound, the villain closed the distance and deflected Jin's strike, causing a ringing noise in his ears.
Between the loud noise, a distinct vibration of a crack forming in the metal was felt. Even surrounded by aura, this fact could not be hidden.
"Ah, were you originally planning to use the swords of other knights in case of an emergency?"
The blade of the Spirit Sword Scissor extended behind the villain's back. He barely dodged by bending his body, but he could not avoid the subsequent vertical slash.
Blood splattered.
The tip of the Bradamante sword grazed his shoulder. The wound was not deep, but the important thing was that Jin successfully landed the first effective hit.
"Back off. Your mission has failed."
"I can't tell."
The villain shrugged his shoulders.
"Just because you're friends with Dante Highran, do you really think Highran would side with Runcandel?"
"Is there any reason they shouldn't?"
"I didn't know you had such a naive side."
"That naivety will bring about the result of my Runcandel and Highran joining forces. A value that neither your master nor the current rotten Runcandel can have."
"We're not getting anywhere."
"It's fine. We don't need to understand each other."
Boom-! Crash-!
This time, it was not the noise from Jin and the villain's fight.
It was from outside. Ron and Belact's battle was getting more intense. Even from so far away, the powerful energy from the two was felt intensely.
The entire fortress was filled with a precarious vibration.
"Let's just finish what we started."
Spirit Sword 1st Technique: Soul Slash.
The long sword energy, silent and shadow-like, scraped the villain's front. It was Jin's most confident spirit sword, displaying the will to cut anything.
With that strike, the villain's sword finally broke and fell to the ground.
Clink-!
However, the villain didn't seem surprised, as if he had expected this to happen.
Something sharp emerged from his sleeve.
'A claw!?'
It was a weapon not used by many. It was also a weapon symbolizing the MacLoran family, the main house of Gilly.
Was the Black Knight from MacLoran?
The moment that question arose.
The villain's claw, which sprung like an arrow, came close to Jin's face.
'Was the claw his main weapon...?'
He thought it was fortunate that the villain was holding such an unimpressive weapon.
But the villain's true weapon was this claw. A clearly ancient artifact made of ten-thousand-year-old iron, Jin could no longer claim a weapon advantage.
"You have a knack for surprising people, huh?"
Screech, scratch!
The claw and blade interlocked, creating an unpleasant friction sound. The villain, who had drawn a new weapon, showed a completely different movement from before.
'Somehow, when I first saw the villain, I had a dangerous intuition, but I didn't think it was that extraordinary. I thought it was just because of the weapon.'
With every movement of the claw, three strands of sword energy were fired. The dazzling sword energy from the two claws, moving dozens of times per second, was blinding.
If he hadn't activated his spirit armor, he would have already suffered minor cuts all over his body.
"Wasn't it important for you to hide your identity? Using such an identifiable weapon."
"As long as there are no witnesses left, it doesn't matter."
"I'm the only witness, aren't I?"
"Yes, that means I'll eliminate you."
"That's a rather brutal joke. Killing me now would be a huge loss for Runcandel, don't you think?"
The villain didn't respond and reached out with his claw.
Jin had only fought a few opponents using claws. Practically speaking, he had only sparred with Gilly a few times after becoming a knight and unsealing her.
-'I'm definitely much stronger than Gilly, but it feels quite tricky.'

-'The claw is completely different from a sword, my lord. There's nothing to fear from an amateur using it, but if you meet a skilled user... you'll hardly be able to control your sword during battle.'
The conversation they had while casually sparring.
As she advised, it was not easy to control the sword as he wished. The sword was stuck between the claws, limiting its movement.
He blocked with his left hand, while attacking at close range with his right. Despite activating Mualta's Rune, Jin felt chills each time the claw grazed his face.
'This is no joke.'
He tried to counterattack several times while being pushed back, but it was not enough to overcome his momentum.
'It's too dangerous to use Uppercut or Myungwang Army Sword.'
He needed to create distance first.
Although the spirit armor was protecting him, a prolonged close combat would inevitably lead to a fatal injury. However, the villain stubbornly clung to Jin as he stepped back.
Jin unleashed consecutive Soul Slashes, but the villain's claw didn't break like a steel sword. Still, it seemed to have some effect, as the claw's assault briefly slowed down.
Thanks to that, Jin managed to secure a ten-step distance and planned to maintain it while continuing the fight.
Unless he possessed far superior swordsmanship than the villain, there was little he could do in close combat.
Suddenly, the villain changed targets.
'Dante!'
The villain had been aiming for Dante from the beginning. He had deliberately lured Jin to create distance before attempting to capture Dante and escape.
Jin and the villain lunged towards Dante simultaneously.
With a ten-step difference, the villain reached Dante first.
The villain's shining claw was heading for the fallen Dante's neck, seemingly indifferent to whether he kidnapped or killed Dante.
At the moment the claw was about to pierce Dante's neck, Jin threw his Bradamante, blocking the claw's path, and drew Sigmund simultaneously.
However, it was inevitable that his stance would be disrupted due to hastily throwing the sword, and the villain redirected the claw from Dante towards Jin.
Crash-!
The claw pierced the spirit armor, and Jin spat out a mouthful of blood.
